fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the new project. Equals path if not provided.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Repository name for new project. Generated based on name if not provided (generated as lowercase with dashes). Starting with GitLab 14.9, path must not start or end with a special character and must not contain consecutive special characters.

fields.name: allow_merge_on_skipped_pipeline
fields.description: Set whether or not merge requests can be merged with skipped jobs.

fields.name: only_allow_merge_if_all_status_checks_passed
fields.description: Indicates that merges of merge requests should be blocked unless all status checks have passed. Defaults to false. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/369859) in GitLab 15.5 with feature flag `only_allow_merge_if_all_status_checks_passed` disabled by default.

fields.name: analytics_access_level
fields.description: One of `disabled`, `private` or `enabled`

fields.name: approvals_before_merge
fields.description: How many approvers should approve merge requests by default. To configure approval rules, see [Merge request approvals API](merge_request_approvals.md).

fields.name: auto_cancel_pending_pipelines
fields.description: Auto-cancel pending pipelines. This isn't a boolean, but enabled/disabled.

fields.name: auto_devops_deploy_strategy
fields.description: Auto Deploy strategy (`continuous`, `manual` or `timed_incremental`).

fields.name: auto_devops_enabled
fields.description: Enable Auto DevOps for this project.

fields.name: autoclose_referenced_issues
fields.description: Set whether auto-closing referenced issues on default branch.

fields.name: avatar
fields.description: Image file for avatar of the project.

fields.name: build_git_strategy
fields.description: The Git strategy. Defaults to `fetch`.

fields.name: build_timeout
fields.description: The maximum amount of time, in seconds, that a job can run.

fields.name: builds_access_level
fields.description: One of `disabled`, `private`, or `enabled`.

fields.name: ci_config_path
fields.description: The path to CI configuration file.

fields.name: container_expiration_policy_attributes
fields.description: Update the image cleanup policy for this project. Accepts: `cadence` (string), `keep_n` (integer), `older_than` (string), `name_regex` (string), `name_regex_delete` (string), `name_regex_keep` (string), `enabled` (boolean). See the [Container Registry](../user/packages/container_registry/reduce_container_registry_storage.md#use-the-cleanup-policy-api) documentation for more information on `cadence`, `keep_n` and `older_than` values.

fields.name: container_registry_access_level
fields.description: Set visibility of container registry, for this project, to one of `disabled`, `private` or `enabled`.

fields.name: container_registry_enabled
fields.description: _(Deprecated)_ Enable container registry for this project. Use `container_registry_access_level` instead.

fields.name: default_branch
fields.description: The [default branch](../user/project/repository/branches/default.md) name. Requires `initialize_with_readme` to be `true`.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Short project description.

fields.name: emails_disabled
fields.description: Disable email notifications.

fields.name: external_authorization_classification_label
fields.description: The classification label for the project.

fields.name: forking_access_level
fields.description: One of `disabled`, `private`, or `enabled`.

fields.name: group_with_project_templates_id
fields.description: For group-level custom templates, specifies ID of group from which all the custom project templates are sourced. Leave empty for instance-level templates. Requires `use_custom_template` to be true.

fields.name: import_url
fields.description: URL to import repository from. When this isn't empty, you must not set `initialize_with_readme` to `true`. Doing so might result in the [following error](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/360266): `not a git repository`.

fields.name: initialize_with_readme
fields.description: Whether to create a Git repository with just a `README.md` file. Default is `false`. When this is true, you must not pass `import_url` or other attributes of this endpoint which specify alternative contents for the repository. Doing so might result in the [following error](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/360266): `not a git repository`.

fields.name: issues_access_level
fields.description: One of `disabled`, `private`, or `enabled`.

fields.name: issues_enabled
fields.description: _(Deprecated)_ Enable issues for this project. Use `issues_access_level` instead.

fields.name: jobs_enabled
fields.description: _(Deprecated)_ Enable jobs for this project. Use `builds_access_level` instead.

fields.name: lfs_enabled
fields.description: Enable LFS.

fields.name: merge_method
fields.description: Set the [merge method](#project-merge-method) used.

fields.name: merge_pipelines_enabled
fields.description: Enable or disable merge pipelines.

fields.name: merge_requests_access_level
fields.description: One of `disabled`, `private`, or `enabled`.

fields.name: merge_requests_enabled
fields.description: _(Deprecated)_ Enable merge requests for this project. Use `merge_requests_access_level` instead.

fields.name: merge_trains_enabled
fields.description: Enable or disable merge trains.

fields.name: mirror_trigger_builds
fields.description: Pull mirroring triggers builds.

fields.name: mirror
fields.description: Enables pull mirroring in a project.

fields.name: namespace_id
fields.description: Namespace for the new project (defaults to the current user's namespace).

fields.name: only_allow_merge_if_all_discussions_are_resolved
fields.description: Set whether merge requests can only be merged when all the discussions are resolved.

fields.name: only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds
fields.description: Set whether merge requests can only be merged with successful pipelines. This setting is named [**Pipelines must succeed**](../user/project/merge_requests/merge_when_pipeline_succeeds.md#require-a-successful-pipeline-for-merge) in the project settings.

fields.name: operations_access_level
fields.description: One of `disabled`, `private`, or `enabled`.

fields.name: packages_enabled
fields.description: Enable or disable packages repository feature.

fields.name: pages_access_level
fields.description: One of `disabled`, `private`, `enabled`, or `public`.

fields.name: printing_merge_request_link_enabled
fields.description: Show link to create/view merge request when pushing from the command line.

fields.name: public_builds
fields.description: If `true`, jobs can be viewed by non-project members.

fields.name: releases_access_level
fields.description: One of `disabled`, `private`, or `enabled`.

fields.name: environments_access_level
fields.description: One of `disabled`, `private`, or `enabled`.

fields.name: feature_flags_access_level
fields.description: One of `disabled`, `private`, or `enabled`.

fields.name: infrastructure_access_level
fields.description: One of `disabled`, `private`, or `enabled`.

fields.name: monitor_access_level
fields.description: One of `disabled`, `private`, or `enabled`.

fields.name: remove_source_branch_after_merge
fields.description: Enable `Delete source branch` option by default for all new merge requests.

fields.name: repository_access_level
fields.description: One of `disabled`, `private`, or `enabled`.

fields.name: repository_storage
fields.description: Which storage shard the repository is on. _(administrator only)_

fields.name: request_access_enabled
fields.description: Allow users to request member access.

fields.name: requirements_access_level
fields.description: One of `disabled`, `private` or `enabled`

fields.name: resolve_outdated_diff_discussions
fields.description: Automatically resolve merge request diffs discussions on lines changed with a push.

fields.name: security_and_compliance_access_level
fields.description: (GitLab 14.9 and later) Security and compliance access level. One of `disabled`, `private`, or `enabled`.

fields.name: shared_runners_enabled
fields.description: Enable shared runners for this project.

fields.name: snippets_access_level
fields.description: One of `disabled`, `private`, or `enabled`.

fields.name: snippets_enabled
fields.description: _(Deprecated)_ Enable snippets for this project. Use `snippets_access_level` instead.

fields.name: squash_option
fields.description: One of `never`, `always`, `default_on`, or `default_off`.

fields.name: tag_list
fields.description: _([Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/328226) in GitLab 14.0)_ The list of tags for a project; put array of tags, that should be finally assigned to a project. Use `topics` instead.

fields.name: template_name
fields.description: When used without `use_custom_template`, name of a [built-in project template](../user/project/working_with_projects.md#create-a-project-from-a-built-in-template). When used with `use_custom_template`, name of a custom project template.

fields.name: template_project_id
fields.description: When used with `use_custom_template`, project ID of a custom project template. This is preferable to using `template_name` since `template_name` may be ambiguous.

fields.name: topics
fields.description: The list of topics for a project; put array of topics, that should be finally assigned to a project. _([Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/328226) in GitLab 14.0.)_

fields.name: use_custom_template
fields.description: Use either custom [instance](../user/admin_area/custom_project_templates.md) or [group](../user/group/custom_project_templates.md) (with `group_with_project_templates_id`) project template.

fields.name: visibility
fields.description: See [project visibility level](#project-visibility-level).

fields.name: wiki_access_level

fields.name: wiki_enabled
fields.description: _(Deprecated)_ Enable wiki for this project. Use `wiki_access_level` instead.

fields.description: The ID of a discussion to resolve. This fills out the issue with a default description and mark the discussion as resolved. Use in combination with `merge_request_to_resolve_discussions_of`.

fields.name: id

fields.description: The user ID of the new member or multiple IDs separated by commas

fields.description: A valid access level

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: A date string in the format `YEAR-MONTH-DAY`

fields.name: invite_source
fields.description: The source of the invitation that starts the member creation process. See [this issue](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/327120).

fields.name: tasks_to_be_done
fields.description: Tasks the inviter wants the member to focus on. The tasks are added as issues to a specified project. The possible values are: `ci`, `code` and `issues`. If specified, requires `tasks_project_id`. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/69299) in GitLab 14.5 [with a flag](../administration/feature_flags.md) named `invite_members_for_task`. Disabled by default.

fields.name: tasks_project_id
fields.description: The project ID in which to create the task issues. If specified, requires `tasks_to_be_done`. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/69299) in GitLab 14.5 [with a flag](../administration/feature_flags.md) named `invite_members_for_task`. Disabled by default.

commit_create.heading: Create a commit with multiple files and actions

fields.name: id
fields.description: The ID or [URL-encoded path of the project](index.md#namespaced-path-encoding)

fields.name: branch
fields.description: Name of the branch to commit into. To create a new branch, also provide either `start_branch` or `start_sha`, and optionally `start_project`.

fields.name: commit_message
fields.description: Commit message

fields.name: start_branch
fields.description: Name of the branch to start the new branch from

fields.name: start_sha
fields.description: SHA of the commit to start the new branch from

fields.name: start_project
fields.description: The project ID or [URL-encoded path of the project](index.md#namespaced-path-encoding) to start the new branch from. Defaults to the value of `id`.

fields.name: actions[]
fields.description: An array of action hashes to commit as a batch. See the next table for what attributes it can take.

fields.name: author_email
fields.description: Specify the commit author's email address

fields.name: author_name
fields.description: Specify the commit author's name

fields.name: stats
fields.description: Include commit stats. Default is true

fields.name: force
fields.description: When `true` overwrites the target branch with a new commit based on the `start_branch` or `start_sha`

fields.name: actions[]
fields.description: Description

fields.name: action
fields.description: The action to perform: `create`, `delete`, `move`, `update`, or `chmod`.

fields.name: file_path
fields.description: Full path to the file. For example: `lib/class.rb`.

fields.name: previous_path
fields.description: Original full path to the file being moved. For example `lib/class1.rb`. Only considered for `move` action.

fields.name: content
fields.description: File content, required for all except `delete`, `chmod`, and `move`. Move actions that do not specify `content` preserve the existing file content, and any other value of `content` overwrites the file content.

fields.name: encoding
fields.description: `text` or `base64`. `text` is default.

fields.name: last_commit_id
fields.description: Last known file commit ID. Only considered in update, move, and delete actions.

fields.name: execute_filemode
fields.description: When `true/false` enables/disables the execute flag on the file. Only considered for `chmod` action.
